name: Arnoglossum
desc: Arnoglossum (Arnoglossum plantagineum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 14 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Arnoglossum plantagineum also known as tuberous Indian-plantain, groovestem Indian plantain or prairie Indian plantain, is a North American species of Arnoglossum in the sunflower family.
